text: Ultracode 是 DSH Web 和 desktop 的会话级多 agent 工作流模式。用户可用 /ultracode on、off 或 status 控制当前会话，也可点击 composer 开关。启用后，它加入任务拆解、分阶段协作和核验提示；右侧面板展示工作流阶段、agent 状态、token 和耗时。完整编排需要 DSH 的 workflow 工具，不需额外 API 密钥。

Ultracode adds multi-agent workflows to DSH sessions. Users control the mode with /ultracode or the composer switch. When active, it guides phased task work and verification. A sidebar shows phases, agent status, tokens, and elapsed time. Full orchestration requires the DSH workflow tool.

Ultracode 的功能「会话级开关」：通过 /ultracode 命令或 composer 控件启用、关闭并查询当前会话的工作流模式。
Ultracode 的功能「实质任务编排」：启用时加入任务拆解、分阶段并行、隔离写入和核验流程；仅在 workflow 工具可用时生效。
Ultracode 的功能「工作流运行面板」：在右侧面板查看工作流、阶段和 agent 状态，并查看模型、token、耗时及子会话。
Ultracode 提示实质任务使用多个子 agent，可能增加 token 用量和耗时；可用 /ultracode off 关闭。

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Ultracode：**Dynamic workflows for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

Ultracode is a session mode that turns every substantive task into a multi-agent workflow. Arm it once; the agent scopes the work, writes a `workflow` script, fans out subagents in phases, verifies adversarially, and synthesizes the result.

[](https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode/actions/workflows/test.yml)

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Features：- **Session mode, not a model setting.** `/ultracode [on|off|status]` arms one session. The stance is folded from the command log, so resume, fork, and replay restore it.
- **Workflow-first policy.** While armed, a prompt section after the `workflow` tool's own guidance classifies work as substantive or trivial, requires phases and `pipeline`/`parallel` fan-out, isolates writers, adds adversarial verification, and asks for evidence in the report.
- **Composer switch.** A quiet bordered pill when off; a flat accent tint and dot when armed, plus a thin seam along the composer edge. No gradients, no icon glyphs.
- **Workflow sidebar.** The `ULTRA` badge opens a right-sidebar ledger: running and finished runs, phase cards with progress rails and dots, per-agent status, model, tokens, and wall time, verification tags, a high-fan-out marker, and child-transcript drill-down.
- **Answers from the log.** No new session-event types. One projection folds `/ultracode` command lifecycles; another folds `tool-workflow/*` records and closes runs abandoned by interrupted or forked turns. Phases keep their raw identity; cancelled outcomes stay distinct from fa

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Preset compatibility：| Preset | `workflow` tool | Ultracode behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | yes | Full policy, phases, subagents, verification, and ledger. |
| Creator (`cordis`) | yes | Full; Standard's tools plus plugin-authoring tools. |
| PTC | no; only `run_code` and its SDK | Policy suppressed. The overview reports **Workflow unavailable in this preset**; no workflow runs. PTC can call subagents as SDK bindings, but that is code-level PTC, not a tracked Ultracode workflow. |
| Minimal | no; persistent shell + `read_image` | UI-only. The complete persona also suppresses the policy; the overview reports **Workflow unavailable in this preset**. |
| Custom | depends on its composition | Full when it composes `workflow-ptc` and `tool-workflow`; otherwise the policy is suppressed. |

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Preset compatibility：The policy checks whether `workflow` is model-visible for the agent. The overview warning recognizes the built-in `minimal` and `ptc` presets; a custom preset without workflow gets the suppressed policy but no preset-name warning.

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness with the `workflow` tool and the Web/Desktop right sidebar. Tested with **0.2.1-rc.2**; nearby versions with the same services should work.

@local/dsh-ultracode README · From GitHub：1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install third-party plugin**.
3. Enter the repository URL:

```text
   https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode.git
   ```

A local clone path works too, and keeps the checkout linked for edits.
4. Install and enable the bundle, then **refresh the page once** so the client half loads.

Or ask your DSH agent to install the bundle from the same URL.

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Local clone：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Big-Smarty/dsh-ultracode.git
cd dsh-ultracode
npm test
```

Install the cloned directory through **Plugins → Add plugin** as above. The plugin is linked rather than copied, so later edits are picked up after a refresh.

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Usage：| Action | How |
| --- | --- |
| Arm the session | `/ultracode`, or click the Ultracode pill in the composer |
| Disarm | `/ultracode off`, the composer pill, or the panel overview's arm control |
| Check the stance | `/ultracode status` |
| Open the ledger | Click the `ULTRA` badge in the session header, or right sidebar → **Ultracode** |
| Inspect a run | Expand **Finished**, open a phase, click an agent to read its child transcript |

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Usage：Ultracode is per session. Trivial requests — a lookup, a one-line edit, a single command — stay direct and say why. Substantive requests become workflows.

The panel is workflow-focused. Shell and other background jobs remain in DSH's existing jobs control.

@local/dsh-ultracode README · How it works：- `ultracode` projection — `{ active, pending }` folded from `command/run` / `command/done`.
- `ultracodeRuns` projection — run, phase, member, status, and timing data folded from `tool-workflow/run-start|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`, with `turn/end` handling for interrupted and forked turns.
- `ultracode:policy` — a prompt section at order `2650`, after the workflow tool's guidance at `2600`; empty while disarmed.
- Client half — a composer pill, an `ULTRA` badge, an armed seam, and a right-sidebar tab type. Agent model/token/time values join each member's `childId` to the sessions catalog.
@local/dsh-ultracode README · How it works：More detail: [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Development：```bash
npm test
```

The tests use Node's built-in test runner and cover the stance, the workflow ledger, abandoned-run closure, phase identity, cancellation, and checkpoint sanitization. CI runs on every push and pull request.

client.js           Client half: switch, badge, seam, workflow sidebar, styles
cordis.patch.yml    Loads the bundle row
locale/             Plugin-inventory metadata (en, zh)

@local/dsh-ultracode README · Cost and safety：Ultracode deliberately spends more tokens and time: it asks for several child agents per substantive task. `/ultracode off` returns to normal execution immediately.

The plugin runs Host code in-process with your permissions. Install it only if you trust the source. It does not bypass approvals, sandbox policy, plan mode, or tool restrictions.
